This is a semantic error; if sheep are on chairs, the chairs are physically underneath them, making the answer 'Yes'. 2) The plan claims there are only 5 chairs (Atom 0 failure), but the prompt asks for 6. While the image indeed shows 5, the reasoning for Atom 3 invalidates the spatial understanding. 3) The 'artifact_observations' claim umbrella shafts merge into sheep heads. Visual inspection shows the shafts clearly terminate above the wool or are held/positioned distinctly; there is no geometric melting/fusion. These hallucinations skew the expert verification weights unnecessarily toward artifact detection rather than counting/semantic accuracy.
